title: Ariana Grande reveals major hair transformation amid career break

 KiMi Robinson USA TODAY Updated Oct. 22, 2026, 7:40 p.m. ET Hear this story The old Ari can't come to the phone right now.
 Ariana Grande revealed her latest transformation on Instagram on Oct. 22, revealing a shoulder-length, dark brown bob with flipped-out ends.
 Hairstylist Brandon Pietsch shared in his own Instagram post that he'd done a cut and color for Grande and wrote, "The ponytail is taking a hiatus 🙊."
 The look is among the shortest lengths she's sported in recent years and is similar to how her hair was styled as a Catwoman-like character in " The Boy is Mine " music video from June 2024.
 The 33-year-old singer-actress has been keeping a low profile since concluding her Eternal Sunshine Tour on Sept. 1. As the tour closed with a 10-night residency at London's O2 Arena, her hair flowed past her lower back. During the shows , it was styled up in a reimagined version of her signature high ponytail and in a ballerina bun.
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. Grande previously explained the hairstyle that at one point became synonymous with her image, sharing in a 2014 post that "I wear extensions but I wear it in a ponytail because my actually hair is so broken."
 '17 wonderful years': Ariana Grande revealed her beloved dog Coco has died A month before the end of the tour, her representatives announced that she would be "taking a step back from visibility" after wrapping the 41-date jaunt. This is "a much-deserved break from public-facing work and appearances which has led to endless, ongoing public scrutiny," her team said.
 Grande's recent work included spending the past year promoting a second "Wicked" film , touring for the first time in six years and releasing her eighth studio album . Meanwhile, she also ended a three-year relationship and has alluded to reigniting a romance with her ex-boyfriend and former backup dancer, Ricky Álvarez.
 Grande's next film, the "Little Fockers" sequel "Focker-in-Law," is set for release Nov. 25.
